rubric.role_summary: New graduate software engineer building games and game-engine features for a London-based multiplayer gaming platform.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
New graduate software engineer building games and game-engine features for a London-based multiplayer gaming platform.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2026 or 2027 new graduate.
- Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related subject, OR equivalent practical experience.
- Some professional software engineering experience through internships OR scaled side projects.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience developing games, game engines, or mods through side projects.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater London, United Kingdom area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

must_haves.source_quote: Some professional experience in software engineering, either through internships, or scaled side projects.

preferences.source_quote: Experience developing games, game engines or modding through side projects.

location.requirement_text: Location: Greater London, United Kingdom area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: We’re a profitable video game start-up in London with 15 million monthly players and we’re hiring New Grad Software Engineers (2026 or 2027)  to join our 11-person founding team.
A permanent desk in our King’s Cross office

soft_requirements: Passion for gaming and interest in building games for large player communities.
Strong engineering fundamentals and product sense; willingness to work across game design, UI/UX, and community management and learn from player feedback.
Interest in difficult engineering problems and voxel, sandbox, and multiplayer games.
Willingness to learn TypeScript, React, WebGL, and Node if not already familiar with them.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)

implied_evidence.user_instruction: Change the scoring such that for must-have criteria, it can still score as a pass if this is implied. Change any impossible or largely unstated must haves to preferences rather than must-haves. On the secondary reviewer, we should also score implied experience/competence as a pass. Make these changes to every role.
